title: Static unit measurements
responsibility: Measures owned source, complexity, dependencies and emitted target sizes while stating unavailable or partial results.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.unit
inputs.description: Unit manifest whose source, dependencies and runtime targets define the measurement scope.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.files
inputs.description: Source-file facts by owned path, including read/coverage state, blocks and references.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.testedRevision
inputs.description: Verified revision attached to every emitted measurement.

inputs.name: unitMeasurements.artifacts
inputs.description: Optional path-indexed built-artifact sizes and SHA-256 digests, default empty.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose Wasm and process execution targets should be selected.

outputs.name: unitMeasurements
outputs.description: Source bytes/lines, complexity, dependency count and per-target artifact bytes, with null values and unavailable reasons or partial notes where appropriate. Measurements have no workload/profile and are attributed to the supplied revision.

outputs.name: emittedTargets
outputs.description: Only runtime targets of kind wasm or process, in manifest order.
